code: int seg = dwfl_segment_report_module (dwfl, ndx, NULL, &dwfl_elf_phdr_memory_callback, elf, core_file_read_eagerly, elf, note_file, note_file_size, &r_debug_info);
note: The submitted core file's PT_LOAD segment is passed into module sniffing; the embedded ELF module and its PT_NOTE program header are input-controlled through this Elf handle.
The PT_NOTE p_filesz from the embedded module controls how many note bytes are exposed to the note parser.
The descriptor bound check only verifies that the declared descriptor fits in the note segment; it does not enforce the missing maximum GNU build-id descriptor length before the size is used.
The attacker-controlled GNU build-id descriptor size is copied directly into the build-id length field.
The unbounded build-id length drives an excessive allocation; this candidate declares a multi-megabyte NT_GNU_BUILD_ID descriptor.
